container_format.payload_width: fp32 (4 B) default; tensors named '#h'-suffixed carry fp16 (2 B); 'dtype.table' (fp32, one itemsize per record, record order)
container_format.note: the v1 reader (runtime/py/pt.py, runtime/src/weights.c) assumes 4 B payloads; the runtime lane must honour the per-record width (dtype.table) for v2.1

notes: dtype policy (measured, docs/v21_plan.md): fp32 encoder/flow/dp conv weights, fp16 decoder conv weights (measured 67.4 dB for that set), fp16 activations are free (87.9 dB); embeddings, LayerNorm, Softmax, flow scales and the iSTFT head stay fp32.
fp16 payload tensors are the decoder conv_pre/ups./resblocks. weights; their values are exactly round_fp16(ONNX weight) - gate (a) checks against that reference.
v2.1 activations are [N,C,T] for convs and [N,T,C] around the encoder attention/LayerNorm; the Transpose entries in `layers` are the boundaries the runtime folds into its own layout.
26 MatMul nodes have no weights (attention scores/values, iSTFT cos-sin basis): the runtime must run them as real GEMMs, they are not K=1 convs like v1's linears.

The iSTFT head is: subband_conv_post -> [4 subbands, 16 bins] magnitude/phase -> Exp/Sin/Cos -> Einsum bkt,kn->bnt with a 16x16 constant basis -> three stride-4 ConvTransposes (two of them constant delta kernels = zero-insert upsamplers, one with a ScatterND-built 4x4x4 kernel) -> Pad -> the 63-tap [1,4,63] lowpass to `wav`.
/dec/ConvTranspose_2's kernel is computed by the graph (ScatterND of 1/4 into a 4x4x4 zero tensor, x4); it is exported from a probe dump, see dynamic_weight().
zh-TW front-end coverage: known gap, not measured (g2pw is not ported); this export covers the phoneme-id graph only.
